notes.title: Update 0.0.1
notes.content:
Our first update for Bit Storm VR: First Loop is now live consisting of minor bug fixes and difficulty adjustments based on community feedback.

Thanks to everyone for the feedback we've received so far!

Changelog 0.0.1


Greatly increased the ammo reload area

Added new fonts for menus and enemy death kills.

Added animations to enemy death text
	
Increased the chance of ammo dropping on normal

Increased the base ammo capacity in the Lunar Revolver

Menu pointer no longer shows when grabbing or two handed aiming with a weapon

Added more variety to the enemy squad spawns

Increased vibration for swords hitting enemies

It’s pay day. Players now start the game with 15,000 ather

Decreased the amount of time between teleports

Reduced the amount of kills needed to trigger certain story events on normal

Other minor bug fixes
